text_blocks.snippet: For most children, COVID-19 treatment focuses on supportive care like rest, hydration, and fever management. Antiviral medications are sometimes prescribed for children at high risk of severe illness, but these are used selectively. Hospitalization may be necessary for severe cases or complications, with treatments including medications, IV fluids, and oxygen.
